decision.comment:
Reporting stage is internally consistent and complete. All cross-artefact references verified:

(1) Accuracy consistency: base_test_accuracy (0.905571) in the abstention report matches evaluation_report.accuracy (0.905571). Confusion-matrix diagonal sum (6502) / n_samples (7180) = 0.905571, confirming the reported figure.

(2) OOD aggregate correctness: ood_auroc = 0.776469 = (0.91225 + 0.859081 + 0.558075)/3 (arithmetic mean of max_softmax AUROCs across three severities). ood_validation_auroc = 0.846789 = (0.983162 + 0.967768 + 0.589439)/3. Both computed per the required protocol (mean of per-severity AUROCs, not pooled-sample AUROC).

(3) Sample counts: prediction_artifact.test_samples (7180) = evaluation_report.n_samples (7180). human_review_queue.count (2442) = abstention_report.human_review_count (2442). Confusion-matrix row sums match per-class support values exactly.

(4) Selective risk: selective_risk (0.043689) equals test_risk at target_validation_coverage 0.8 in the risk_coverage_curve. Threshold (0.89294279) is consistent across both fields.

(5) Data integrity: data_audit_report passed all checks; train/validation overlap = 0; test_inspected = false. No leakage indicators.

(6) All four anomaly reviews (training, evaluation, configuration_replay, abstention) returned action=continue, severity=ok, deterministic_issues=[]. No deterministic findings at the reporting stage either.

Advisory items carried forward (non-blocking, no action required at this stage):
- Test coverage (0.6599) is ~14 pp below target validation coverage (0.8001); the abstention threshold generalizes conservatively, so effective abstain rate on unseen data will exceed the validation-calibrated 0.34.
- OOD AUROC at σ=0.4 drops to 0.558 (max_softmax) / 0.492 (predictive_entropy), near or below chance; the corruption proxy has limited discriminative power at high severity. The ood_scope label 'controlled_corruption_proxy' appropriately scopes this.
- Per-class weaknesses: cancer-associated stroma (recall 0.546, F1 0.659) and smooth muscle (F1 0.735) are the weakest classes and may drive disproportionate abstention.
- ~9 pp gap between best validation accuracy (0.995) and test accuracy (0.906) is noted for downstream interpretation.
- Prior-art quotes (ghostnet_vgg_robustness, temp_scaling_calibration) extend beyond truncated source text; verify against full papers before encoding further design decisions.
- llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8; exact LLM weights not pinned (auxiliary, non-blocking).

No deterministic findings. No schema violations. All artefact SHA-256 hashes are present. The dossier is complete through the abstention stage with 37 artefact versions and 83 decision events. Reporting is consistent and ready for final sign-off.
